activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 5 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: The rooftop garden removed the need for cooling.
cards.explanation: A slight reduction does not mean cooling is no longer needed.

cards.statement: Sharing agendas was associated with less repeated discussion.
cards.explanation: The passage links the organisational changes with less repetition.

cards.statement: The audio-guide ratings definitely represent every visitor.
cards.explanation: Self-selection means the ratings cannot definitely represent every visitor.

cards.statement: The timetable result covers the whole network.
cards.explanation: Only two routes were observed and other routes still need monitoring.

cards.statement: The two neighbourhoods had identical age profiles.
cards.explanation: The passage says their age profiles were different.

activities.explanation: Cada carta repasa una regla del tema; revisa las falladas al terminar el mazo.

cards.explanation: Both sides of the trade-off are stated directly.

cards.statement: The mentoring result can automatically be applied to every absent student.
cards.explanation: The unknown participation of the most absent students prevents that generalisation.
